About Me

I am a Technical AI Governance Fellow at Pivotal Research and a PhD Candidate in the UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training in Accountable, Responsible and Transparent AI at the University of Bath. My research focuses on the legal alignment of AI agents and the compliance of language models with policies, regulations, and expert-defined standards.

At Pivotal Research, I work with Noam Kolt. I also collaborate with Ben Brady and Cullen O’Keefe at the Institute for Law & AI on benchmarks for law-following AI. My doctoral research is supervised by Harish Tayyar Madabushi and Gail Forey.
